summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson, a right-handed male with mixed Hodgkin's and non-Hodgkin's lymphoma involving the central nervous system and eyes, was admitted for his tenth maintenance cycle of high-dose methotrexate and second dose of rituximab. He was pre-medicated with dexamethasone and Benadryl prior to rituximab to prevent infusion reactions and received IV fluids and sodium bicarbonate during methotrexate infusion to protect his kidneys. He developed transient transaminitis, which improved with increased leucovorin and hydration. Methotrexate levels declined appropriately, and a follow-up MRI showed no new lesions or evidence of lymphoma recurrence. He was discharged home in stable condition on a prednisone taper, three days of leucovorin, and sodium bicarbonate, with instructions to monitor for concerning symptoms and attend follow-up appointments.
